Overview

Hampton is a city in VA with a population of 135,000. Hampton Roads city with Langley Air Force Base and the Hampton Coliseum. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
